items.description: After a Springing Event, Guarantor must promptly pay and perform all Obligations under the SPV Lease upon Landlord's demand, and immediately for any past due Obligations.
items.span_text: Upon, and from and after, the occurrence of any one or more of the Springing Events, Guarantor will, upon demand from Landlord, promptly pay and perform all of the Obligations, when and as due as provided under the SPV Lease and immediately for any past due Obligations.
items.trigger: Upon, and from and after, the occurrence of any one or more of the Springing Events

items.description: Guarantor must give Landlord written notice of any Springing Event within a redacted number of days, with a detailed explanation and copies of relevant agreements or correspondence.
items.span_text: Guarantor shall provide written notice to Landlord of the occurrence of any Springing Event within [***] days after the occurrence thereof, which notice shall contain a detailed explanation of such Springing Event along with copies of any relevant agreements or correspondence.

items.description: The date on which any Springing Event occurs, from which Guarantor's guaranty obligations spring.
items.name: Springing Event Trigger Date
items.span_text: the date of such occurrence, the “Springing Event Trigger Date”
